title: perform: request
description: Run one actor as config defines it, and record the run. A request names only the actor, its direction and whether to rehearse: never a runner, options, an effect check, a host path, a command line or a policy value.

direction.description: What the actor is asked to do in this run. Absent means the empty string.

rehearse.description: Run every check, start nothing, and report what would run. Absent means false.
